Set \(P=(0,0)\) and \(Q=(8,0)\). Since \(\angle BPQ=60^\circ\), write
\[
B=\left(\frac t2,\frac{\sqrt3 t}{2}\right).
\]
Because \(B\) is the midpoint of \(QR\),
\[
R=2B-Q=(t-8,\sqrt3 t).
\]
Now \(QR=12\), so
\[
(t-16)^2+3t^2=144
\]
\[
4t^2-32t+112=0
\]
\[
t^2-8t+28=0.
\]
The discriminant is
\[
(-8)^2-4(28)=-48<0,
\]
so no real \(t\) exists. Therefore no such triangle exists, and the length of \(XZ\) is undefined.

\[
\boxed{\text{No such triangle exists}}
\]
